influences.name: Elvis Presley
influences.context: I listened to a British radio station called Radio Luxembourg. Radio Luxembourg, your station of the stars, And so I heard for the first time Elvis Presley, Cliff Richards, The Shadows, Brenda Lee, young artists like that. Neil Sedaka. And I had no interest for anything else than this kind of music.
